# Kashmir Construction Group (KCG)

> Construction and development company based in Dadyal, Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Pakistan. Builds homes, commercial buildings and infrastructure, and supplies ready-mix concrete from its own batching plant, across Dadyal, Mirpur, Kotli and nearby towns in Azad Kashmir and Punjab.

Kashmir Construction Group (KCG) is a separate company from Kashmir Builders and Developers (Rawalpindi), Kashmir Pre-Engineered Construction (KAPEC), JK Builders & Developers (Srinagar) and other similarly named firms.

## Leadership
- Akeeb Yakoob: Founder & Proprietor, Operations Manager, Head of Logistics
- Bilaal Hussain: Co-Founder, Head of Marketing & Admin, Company Bookkeeper

## Services
- Residential construction (new homes, including for families living in the UK and abroad)
- Commercial buildings (shops, offices, plazas)
- Infrastructure (roads, drainage, site works)
- Ready-mix concrete and concrete batching plants
- Project management
- Renovations and extensions
